discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in `1544b995b`. `suggestion()` in `candidates.ts` now clips `prompt` to `PROMPT_MAX_CHARS` and `why` to `WHY_MAX_CHARS` before it hashes the id, so rule, model and turn rows all stay inside the published bounds. Text within the limits is unchanged, so the `host-rules.json` parity fixtures keep their ids. `contracts.test.ts` builds rows from a long task title, a status headline and a failing check list, and validates the set and push against `NextTurnSet` and `NextTurnTrayPush`.

Fixed in 85ba54c1e8. When a Skip names a row that sits before the cursor (one New set already paged past), the cursor now moves back by one. Only the skipped row leaves the pool, and the rows on screen stay put. A test pins your sequence: New set, then a late Skip for Verify, leaves Review/Wrap up/Next step in view, and Undo skip brings Verify back to the front. I also fuzzed 4,000 random verb sequences offline against "a skip hides only its row, more drops only the last row, Undo skip brings its row into view". The fuzzer finds this bug without the fix and finds nothing with it.

discussion_comments.comment_body: Good catch. Both assertions now use `should(value)`, which fails on `undefined` instead of short-circuiting. Checked by mutation: with the proto-to-host converter dropping `annotations`, the round-trip test now fails.

Good catch — the code fixtures all carried "overloaded" in the message, so the code check was not covered on its own. Added table-driven cases for each capacity code with a neutral message, plus an unknown code with a neutral message that must stay non-retryable.

Valid, fixed in b49479af3d. The test now keeps the owner's request and asserts that it rejects ("…disconnected before it could respond…") when the owner unregisters, so there's no unhandled rejection. Ran it with unhandled-error reporting checked: none.

Valid, and fixed in 1690c40bf. I removed the cap. Each failure record is what stops its run from falling back to an earlier checkpoint, so failures now persist for the life of the session, as checkpoint history does. Covered by `keeps every failure so no failed run falls back to an earlier checkpoint` in `checkpoint-records.test.ts`; it fails if the cap is put back.

Valid, added. `skills-cli.test.ts` checks the exported value against core's `package.json`: the devDependency must be an exact `x.y.z` (no tag or range) and `SKILLS_CLI_VERSION` / `SKILLS_CLI_PACKAGE` must equal it. I checked that hardcoding `"skills@latest"` back into the constant makes it fail. The call-site tests keep using the constant, as you suggested.

discussion_comments.comment_body: Good catch, fixed. The test now starts waiting before the tracked start rejects and asserts the waiter resolves. I confirmed it fails against a version that tracks the raw start promise, where a failed start rejects existing waiters, and passes against the real implementation.

Valid, thanks. The fixture now uses `Number(undefined)`, so it stays alive when the variable is unset, and the test requires `signal=SIGTERM`, so a fixture that exits on its own can no longer pass it. Without the client's kill, the test now fails at the 20 s timeout.

Valid, thanks. The wire-level test now runs the same assertions through `doStream` as well as `doGenerate`, for both `cline` and `cline-pass`, and checks the request is a streaming one. Removing the headers from the Cline provider fails all four cases.

Agreed. Added `scripts/desktop-startup.test.ts` (`test:sidecar-startup`, wired into the ubuntu sidecar test step in sdk-test.yml): it compiles the real entrypoint, bootstraps an isolated Hub with `--remote-hub-ensure` on an OS-assigned port and a dedicated discovery path, pins the sidecar to that port, and requires the ready line plus a healthy `/health`. It fails with `No compatible hub runtime is available` without the entrypoint fix and passes with it.
